mapper.select: with affected_users as ( select user_id from sys_user_role where role_id = #{roleId} ), entry_stats as ( select ur.user_id, count(distinct r.entry_type) entry_type_count, bool_or(r.entry_type is null) has_unclassified_role, bool_or(r.entry_type = 'LEARNING') has_learning_role, bool_or(r.entry_type = 'ADMIN') has_admin_role, bool_or(r.role_key = 'student') has_student_role from sys_user_role ur join affected_users au on au.user_id = ur.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' group by ur.user_id ) select es.user_id from entry_stats es where es.entry_type_count > 1 or es.has_unclassified_role or ( es.has_learning_role and ( not es.has_student_role or not exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role_menu rm on rm.role_id = ur.role_id join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where ur.user_id = es.user_id and m.perms = 'certmuse:student' ) ) ) or ( es.has_admin_role and not exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role_menu rm on rm.role_id = ur.role_id join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where ur.user_id = es.user_id and m.perms = 'certmuse:entry:admin' ) )
